# Swagger UI distribution

The two bundled static files are unmodified files from the official npm
`swagger-ui-dist` package, version 5.36.0, published by the Swagger UI project.
They allow the FastAPI documentation to run without contacting a CDN.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/swagger-ui-dist/v/5.36.0

The included `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` apply to these files. Only the JavaScript
bundle and stylesheet are used; application code and database design are separate.
